about.body1: Entrenuts is a healthy food company born in Colón, Entre Ríos, out of the dream of three friends who decided to build something of their own.
about.body2: We started producing on March 20, 2020 — yes, the very day Argentina declared its mandatory lockdown. While the world came to a halt, we were just getting started. That contrast shaped the spirit we grew with: in just six years, we went from an idea among friends to a brand with nationwide and international reach.
about.body3: Today we have two production plants and a team of nearly 100 people. We distribute our products across every province in the country and export to 10 countries, taking quality healthy food far beyond our borders.
about.body4: We are a young company, but we work with the seriousness and commitment of those who build for the long term. That combination of youth, professionalism and responsibility is what lets us grow without losing our identity.
about.body5: We make peanut butter, coconut oil, honey, protein bars, protein premixes, protein puffs and ghee, all under one principle: caring for what people eat is caring for their quality of life. That is why we work every day on continuous improvement, investing in technology, quality and human capital, creating new opportunities for work and growth for everyone who is part of this project.
about.missionSubtitle: So more people can live better.
